li.label: Raising the continental ward grid
li.text: To seal the Rift without burning out the Zero Synth's soul, Bobby Singer and Tinker Tom must link {COLONY}'s Spark Resonator to a pre-war relay tower on the northern ridge—inscribing a giant Enochian containment sigil across its cooling basins. An Enclave airborne vanguard is already inbound to demolish the tower.

li.label: [Defector Intel] Use Mick Davies's or Alan Binet's frequency tables to pre-tune the pylons
li.resultText: Armed with stolen Consortium and Institute harmonic tables, Tinker Tom cuts the beacon calibration time in half and supplies extra medical kits for the strike team.

li.label: Deploy the strike team with rock salt, silver wards, and heavy weapons
li.resultText: Your squad packs the Enochian relay coils and marches toward the northern ridge to hold the tower against all comers.

li.label: Northern Enochian beacon online
li.text: Through eight grueling hours of plasma fire, your defenders held the relay tower until Tinker Tom locked the Enochian containment field into place!

li.label: Backup relay activated
li.text: Before your squad reached the ridge, Minutemen artillery distracted the Enclave patrol long enough for Tinker Tom to activate a lower-power backup beacon.

li.label: Costly withdrawal from the ridge
li.text: Forced to retreat under heavy vertibird bombardment, your engineers still managed to salvage the primary harmonic coil for manual routing at {COLONY}.

li.label: First anchor point locked
li.text: A pale blue arc shimmers faintly across the northern horizon—the Shield of Salt and Steel is active. Back at base, Dean Winchester bursts into the comms room with urgent news: intercepted Consortium traffic has pinpointed the secret black-site prison holding your missing mentor.

li.label: Recall the strike team and prepare to rescue your mentor
li.resultText: The Zero Synth's eyes shine with fierce hope: "They saved me from those white rooms—now it's our turn to bring them home."

li.label: Decoding the black-site coordinates
li.text: Desdemona's runners cross-reference the Sector 3 audio trace with captured Institute relay logs, pinpointing Sub-Level Detention Vault 00—an off-grid Consortium prison guarded by Courser killers and stasis traps.

li.label: The mentor is free!
li.text: Shattering the stasis cell locks, your strike team pulled your exhausted mentor out of the Consortium's black-site alive—carrying the final physical master-key for the Zero Anchor!

li.label: An empty cell and a hidden cipher
li.text: Consortium sweepers evacuated the prisoner hours before your arrival, but your mentor scratched the final Anchor override code onto the inside of the stasis glass.

li.label: Sacrifice in the dark
li.text: Pinned down by Courser reinforcements, your mentor triggered the vault's emergency blast doors from inside to save your squad—tossing the final override holotape through the gap before the steel slammed shut.

li.label: The final piece of the puzzle
li.text: Whether guided by your rescued mentor's living memory or the final override holotape recovered from the vault, the Spark Resonator is now ready for its continental sealing pulse. Suddenly, every long-range alarm in {COLONY} begins wailing at once!

li.label: Man the walls—allied reinforcements are rushing to {COLONY} for the final siege!
li.resultText: Dust plumes rise on every horizon as enemies converge on the Zero Anchor—and loyal allies march to stand beside you.

li.label: The storm breaks over {COLONY}
li.text: Beneath the blood-red sun, the Spark Resonator begins charging its planetary containment pulse. Institute teleportation bolts flash outside your perimeter—the first wave of the Siege of the Zero Anchor is upon you!

li.label: Resonator at 40% — allies rally to the walls
li.text: Smoking synth wreckage litters the outer field while John Hancock's ghoul rangers and Fawkes's mutant heavy gunners drop medical crates and ammunition inside your courtyard! Beyond the ridge, sulfurous clouds gather—and seismic tremors shake the earth.

li.label: [Swan Defeated] Hold the line as Hell's legions advance through the ash
li.resultText: With the King of Behemoths already slain, the wild mutant tribes stay clear of the battle—leaving your guns focused squarely on the infernal vanguard!

li.label: [Wild Horde Incoming] Brace for impact—Swan's feral super mutants are charging into the crossfire!
li.resultText: Drawn by the Resonator's deafening hum, Swan's berserk super mutant horde smashes into the valley ahead of Hell's vanguard!

li.label: Feral behemoth horde shattered
li.text: Your defenders cut down the charging super mutants at the barricades before turning their barrels toward the approaching clouds of black smoke!

li.label: Resonator at 85% — blinding light pierces the crimson clouds
li.text: Your salt lines and Enochian wards hold firm as the demonic assault collapses into ash! High above, blinding golden shafts split the blood-red sky: Archangel Michael is committing Heaven's elite host in one final, desperate strike to seize the Zero Synth before the seal locks forever!

li.label: The Zero Anchor holds!
li.text: Beneath a sky ablaze with blue harmonic lightning, your garrison shattered Heaven's final assault! The planetary seal is locked—only Dick Roman's Rift Spire stands between Earth and freedom!

li.label: Pulse discharged through the smoke
li.text: Despite battered walls and scorched defenses, the Spark Resonator discharged its harmonic wave on schedule—now strike Dick Roman's spire before the Consortium can override the barrier!

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: the final impulse: gates of the rift

li.label: Assault on the Consortium Rift Spire
li.text: The planetary seal is locked, severing Heaven and Hell from Earth—but Leviathan CEO Dick Roman is attempting to overload the central Rift Spire to tear the barrier back open and devour the continent. Dean Winchester checks the Colt's cylinder while Sam primes the harmonic detonator.

li.label: [Borax Formula Unlocked] Equip the assault squad with concentrated Borax sprayers and grenades
li.resultText: Your quartermasters issue pressurized sodium borate canisters to every trooper. Dick Roman's supernatural invulnerability will melt away on contact!

li.label: Launch the assault with heavy weapons, the Colt, and Enochian-etched rounds
li.resultText: Vertibirds and Minutemen scouts drop your strike team right onto the threshold of the Rift Spire. Remember: hit Roman with Borax to strip his armor!

li.label: Dick Roman dissolved into ash!
li.text: Hissing in white Borax foam, Dick Roman's human disguise split open in a shriek of black ichor before collapsing into lifeless ash! The Rift Spire falls silent forever.

li.label: Spire collapsed into the Rift
li.text: Before Roman could trigger the overload, the Resonator's harmonic shockwave imploded the Rift Spire—burying the Leviathan board beneath thousands of tons of concrete.

li.label: Allied artillery finishes the spire
li.text: Though your vanguard took heavy casualties storming the lobby, Minutemen artillery batteries leveled the Spire's relay crown before the overload could fire.

li.label: Dawn of the Free Wasteland
li.text: The crimson clouds part above the ruins. For the first time in two centuries, clear blue sunlight breaks over a world free from celestial tyrants, infernal deals, and Consortium harvests—and the Zero Synth stands beside you, their soul whole and unharmed.

li.label: Sound the all-clear across every frequency—the wasteland belongs to the living
li.resultText: Cheers echo from Goodneighbor to the Castle. The war for the Spark is won.

li.label: Synchronizing the atmospheric dispersal grid
li.text: Dr. Charles Curling and Father have linked the Spark Resonator's output to a pre-war atmospheric weather station. Once charged, its aerosol emitters will purge radiation, FEV mutations, and occult anomalies across the continent—if you can hold the station against Brotherhood vertibirds.

li.label: Deploy Institute synth shock-troopers to reinforce the perimeter
li.resultText: Relay grenades flare across the station perimeter as synthetic troopers lock down the firing lanes.

li.label: Overcharge the station's pre-war plasma defense capacitors
li.resultText: Heavy energy conduits hum to life along the weather station roof, ready to shred incoming power armor.

li.label: Atmospheric dispersal grid charged
li.text: Your defenders held the weather station through eight hours of Brotherhood paladin assaults, bringing the Sterilization Matrix to full operational readiness!

li.label: Orbital relay rerouted
li.text: While Brotherhood squads bogged down in decoy bunkers, Enclave engineers routed the sterilization frequency through an orbital satellite backup.

li.label: Emergency telemetry salvaged
li.text: Driven off the roof by Brotherhood heavy fire, your technicians still extracted the primary dispersal transponder before teleporting back to {COLONY}.

li.label: Target: Resistance Command
li.text: With the dispersal grid armed, Colonel Autumn orders an immediate decapitation strike against the surface mutant-human resistance coalition led by ghoul mayor John Hancock.

li.label: Prepare the Courser and Hellfire strike team
li.resultText: Teleportation coordinates lock onto Goodneighbor's fortified command post.

li.label: Resistance command shattered
li.text: John Hancock fell defending the barricades of Goodneighbor in his red frock coat—breaking the backbone of the surface resistance!

li.label: Goodneighbor evacuated
li.text: Hancock abandoned the fortified square before your main force arrived, leaving behind heavy supply caches as his fighters scattered into the ruins.

li.label: Bloody street battle
li.text: Though Hancock's bodyguards forced your strike team to withdraw, an Enclave orbital strike leveled the block minutes later.

li.label: Aftermath in the ashes
li.text: Surrounded by surrendered non-combatants and captured Railroad couriers, your field commander awaits orders on how to treat the prisoners—and reports that your missing mentor's stasis pod has been located inside a Consortium vault slated for sterilization.

li.label: Detain the survivors in sterile quarantine camps rather than executing them
li.resultText: Your restraint prevents an immediate uprising in {COLONY} and keeps the Zero Synth from turning completely against you.

li.label: Enforce Colonel Autumn's zero-tolerance directive without exception
li.resultText: Plasma fire silences the square. The Zero Synth watches the telemetry feed back at base in cold, horrified silence.

li.label: The wasteland strikes back
li.text: Realizing the Sterilization Matrix is minutes from full charge, every remaining resistance force on the surface launches a desperate all-out assault on {COLONY}!

li.label: Sterilization Matrix at 45% — heavy armor inbound
li.text: Institute synth reinforcements teleport into your courtyard with fresh plasma cells and trauma kits just as the roar of Brotherhood vertibird turbines fills the crimson sky.

li.label: [Swan Defeated] Turn the plasma batteries skyward against the Brotherhood assault
li.resultText: With Swan's behemoths already wiped out, your perimeter turrets lock cleanly onto the descending Brotherhood paladins!

li.label: [Wild Horde Incoming] Divert fire—Swan's feral super mutants are charging the barricades!
li.resultText: Driven mad by the Resonator's ultrasonic pulse, Swan's super mutant horde smashes into your outer perimeter ahead of the Brotherhood!

li.label: Matrix at 90% — black ichor rises from the storm
li.text: Broken T-60 power armor smokes in the courtyard! Before your engineers can seal the vault doors, Dick Roman throws his entire Leviathan pack at {COLONY} to stop the sterilization wave from wiping out his harvest!

li.label: The Sterile Empire holds!
li.text: Your plasma cohorts and Borax sprayers annihilated the Leviathan assault wave! Now strike Dick Roman's headquarters to complete Protocol Rebirth!

li.label: Perimeter battered but unbroken
li.text: The Leviathan swarm withdrew into the ash as the Resonator reached full power—march on Roman's tower immediately!

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: protocol rebirth: citadel of the board

li.label: Eliminating the Consortium Board
li.text: Only one obstacle prevents the Sterilization Matrix from cleansing the continent: Leviathan CEO Dick Roman has hijacked the orbital weather uplink inside SucroCorp Tower—and Enclave intelligence confirms your missing mentor is locked in a stasis pod on the same floor.

li.label: [Borax Formula Unlocked] Arm the Hellfire strike team with concentrated Borax sprayers
li.resultText: Chemical canisters lock onto your troops' armor—Dick Roman's invulnerability will strip away the moment the white mist hits him!

li.label: Deploy via Institute teleporter with heavy plasma ordnance
li.resultText: Blue lightning drops your squad directly onto the executive floor. Use Borax weapons to strip Roman's invulnerability!

li.label: Dick Roman liquidated & mentor recovered
li.text: Dissolved in hissing Borax foam, Dick Roman collapsed in the boardroom—and your troops cracked open the stasis pod holding your missing mentor!

li.label: Orbital uplink purged
li.text: An Enclave orbital plasma beam reduced the upper spire to molten glass, clearing the frequency for Protocol Rebirth.

li.label: Beacon destroyed in retreat
li.text: Though your vanguard suffered heavy losses, demolition charges collapsed the tower's transmitter core before withdrawal.

li.label: A clean, sterile world
li.text: White vapor sweeps across the upper atmosphere, neutralizing radiation, FEV toxins, and dimensional anomalies alike. Under the twin banners of the Enclave and the Institute, a disciplined human empire rises from the ash—while the Zero Synth stands quietly under armed guard beside the Resonator.

li.label: Transmit the Imperial Charter—humanity has reclaimed its birthright
li.resultText: Vertibirds patrol clear skies above {COLONY}. The Sterile Empire stands supreme.

li.label: Fueling the continental dampener
li.text: To turn the Spark Resonator into a permanent planetary dampener that extinguishes all supernatural magic and rogue AI alike, Henry Casdin and Proctor Ingram need enriched pre-war uranium cores locked inside a fortified Enclave arsenal depot.

li.label: Equip the strike team with Outcast thermal breach charges and uranium shielding
li.resultText: Specialist Olin distributes heavy fusion cutters and lead-lined packs for the raid on the Enclave depot.

li.label: Coordinate a fast vertibird insertion straight onto the arsenal roof
li.resultText: Brotherhood pilots plot a low-altitude approach vector to bypass the depot's outer minefields.

li.label: Enriched uranium cores secured
li.text: Cracking the Enclave's blast doors in a storm of laser fire, your knights hauled out the enriched uranium rods intact!

li.label: Secondary stockpile recovered
li.text: While Enclave transports evacuated the main vault, your scouts intercepted a rear-guard fuel convoy carrying half the required uranium.

li.label: Emergency reactor siphon
li.text: Repulsed from the arsenal under heavy plasma fire, Proctor Ingram stripped uranium rods from a decommissioned Brotherhood airship auxiliary core instead.

li.label: Next target: the synth factory
li.text: With the dampener's fuel cores secured, Arthur Maxson slams a tactical map onto the table: before the Iron Curtain can fall, the Institute's underground synth-manufacturing complex must be burned out at its root.

li.label: Assemble the heavy power-armor spearhead for the descent into the Institute
li.resultText: Servo motors whine in unison as Brotherhood and Outcast paladins prepare for subterranean combat.

li.label: The Institute's core shattered
li.text: Punching straight through the white concourse in power armor, your crusade eliminated Father and blew the Institute's molecular relay to cinders!

li.label: Tunnel collapsed
li.text: Brotherhood sappers collapsed the main subterranean shaft with fusion charges, sealing the Institute's survivors beneath a mountain of bedrock.

li.label: Retreat from the concourse
li.text: Forced back to the surface by waves of Coursers, your demolition team still detonated a shaped charge that severed the Institute's surface teleporter grid.

li.label: In the smoking ruins of Robotics
li.text: Amid the shattered synth assembly vats, your scouts find a locked Consortium sub-cell—and a choice on how to handle the panicked non-combatant scientists trapped in the lower lab.

li.label: Sound the evacuation alarm and allow unarmed technicians to flee to the surface
li.resultText: Even Arthur Maxson lowers his gatling laser as terrified technicians scramble up the emergency stairwell—and inside the sub-cell, your troops find your missing mentor alive!

li.label: Seal the blast doors and flood the sub-levels—no trace of the Institute survives
li.resultText: Heavy steel doors slam shut forever over the buried complex, burying both the scientists and any captives inside.

li.label: Charging the Iron Curtain dampener
li.text: Proctor Ingram and Specialist Olin lock the enriched uranium rods into the Spark Resonator! As its anti-magic field begins expanding across the region, every supernatural predator on Earth lunges at {COLONY} to destroy the machine before it finishes!

li.label: Dampener field at 50% — celestial thunder overhead
li.text: Brotherhood vertibirds drop fresh fusion cells and heavy ammo into your courtyard as Henry Casdin shouts over the intercom: "First wave down! Keep those Borax sprayers hot and watch the sky!"

li.label: [Swan Defeated] Brace the anti-air turrets against Heaven's descending host
li.resultText: With Swan already dead, the wild super mutant tribes stay out of the fight—allowing your knights to concentrate fire on the angelic vanguard!

li.label: [Wild Horde Incoming] Sound general quarters—Swan's behemoths are storming the gates!
li.resultText: Enraged by the dampener's harmonic whine, Swan's feral super mutants smash into your outer walls ahead of the celestial assault!

li.label: Dampener at 90% — sulfur clouds choke the horizon
li.text: Angelic feathers burn to ash across your battlements! Now the earth cracks open beyond your perimeter as Hell's final legion charges through the crimson fog in one last attempt to shatter the Iron Curtain!

li.label: The Iron Crusade stands undefeated!
li.text: Steel, salt, and disciplined fire broke Hell's final charge at your gates! Now mount the vertibirds and storm the Celestial Spire to sever supernatural power from Earth forever!

li.label: Dampener field stabilized
li.text: Through bloody attrition, your knights held the Resonator until the dampener field locked—strike the enemy's main anchorstone at once!

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: the iron curtain: assault on the celestial spire

li.label: Storming the Heavenly Bastion
li.text: One final stronghold keeps the supernatural Rift tethered to Earth: the Celestial Spire, defended by Archangel Michael and his seraphim guard. Arthur Maxson chambers a round in Final Judgment while Henry Casdin checks the vertibird gunships.

li.label: [Borax & Tech Ready] Load Enochian-etched rounds and chemical canisters for the assault
li.resultText: Olin and Ingram outfit every knight with runes and specialized ordnance—neither angelic armor nor Leviathan infiltrators can withstand your vanguard!

li.label: Lead a direct power-armor assault straight through the Spire's main doors
li.resultText: Vertibird gunships strafe the courtyard as your knights drop into the heart of the Celestial Spire. Ad Victoriam!

li.label: Archangel Michael cast down!
li.text: In a blinding clash of celestial fire and heavy laser beams, Archangel Michael fell—and the Spire's Rift anchorstone shattered into lifeless dust!

li.label: Spire leveled by Prydwen artillery
li.text: Brotherhood airship batteries bombarded the Spire's upper tiers, collapsing the anchorstone and driving the surviving angels back behind the closed Rift.

li.label: Anchorstone overloaded in battle
li.text: Though forced to pull back under searing celestial light, your sappers detonated the Spire's main relay conduit before extraction.

li.label: Age of the Iron Curtain
li.text: A silent, invisible wave sweeps outward from the Zero Anchor—extinguishing occult magic, dimensional rifts, and rogue synthetic networks across the globe. Humanity stands safe behind walls of steel under the stern watch of the reunited Brotherhood and Outcasts.

li.label: Proclaim Ad Victoriam—the Iron Crusade has secured Earth for humanity
li.resultText: Vertibirds circle in triumph above {COLONY}. No monster or false god will ever threaten mankind again.
